entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A., Dilip Kumar Chaudhary

Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
1.Heard learned counsel for the applicants and Mr. Dilip Kumar Chaudhary, learned counsel for respondent No.2 who filed vakalatnama today in court which is taken on record, as also learned A.G.A., and perused the record.
2.The instant petition has been filed by the applicants with a prayer to quash the proceedings of Case No. 748 of 2016 case crime No.117 of 2014 under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Para, district Lucknow.

sentences.text:
3.Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the charge sheet was filed against three accused persons, however, the co-accused Ambika Prasad Tripathi has died in 2018 and therefore,
remaining two accused persons have entered into compromise with respondent No.2 and have amicably resolved outside the court by way of compromise which is on record.
It is submitted that on the basis of the compromise, the impugned proceedings are liable to be quashed.

4.Learned counsel for respondent No.2 concedes that the dispute has been amicably settled between the parties and he has no objection if the impugned proceedings are quashed on the basis of compromise after its verification from the competent court.
Learned A.G.A has also no objection in case the impugned proceedings are quashed on the basis of compromise, subject to its verification by the concerned court.
5.Accordingly, having due regard to the submissions made by the parties' counsel, perusal of the compromise as also considering the law laid down by Supreme Court in Lovely Salhotra and another versus State NCT of Delhi and another Criminal Appeal No.670 of 2017 (Petition for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl) No.1666 of 2017) and (2012)10 SCC 303 Gian Singh versus State of Punjab and another, the petition is disposed of with direction to the parties to appear before the trial court on 18.6.2024, which shall verify the compromise in presence of the parties within the next one week.
The trial court shall provide a copy of the verification report to the parties.

sentences.text: A copy of compromise be placed on record of the trial court.
It will be open to the applicants to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings.
For a period of three months, impugned proceedings shall remain in abeyance.
6.Office is directed to return original/certified copy of the compromise to learned counsel for the petitioners and retain a photocopy thereof, under Rules of the Court.
